meta.note: The abbreviation dictionary, Lingvo-style: the siglas Portugal runs on. Half of official mail and every second shop window is written in these; a resident decodes them daily or drowns. The 'say' field carries how the letters are actually read aloud.

cards.note: asked at every till: 'contribuinte?' — same thing
cards.ex_t: Precisa do NIF para abrir conta.
cards.ex_trans: You need the tax number to open an account.

cards.note: 23% standard, 13% and 6% reduced; Madeira runs slightly lower
cards.ex_t: O preço já inclui IVA.
cards.ex_trans: The price already includes VAT.

cards.trans: personal income tax (imposto sobre o rendimento)
cards.note: the spring ritual: entregar o IRS
cards.ex_t: Já entregaste o IRS este ano?
cards.ex_trans: Have you filed your income tax this year?

cards.ex_t: Traga o CC e uma fotocópia.
cards.ex_trans: Bring your ID card and a photocopy.

cards.trans: national health service (serviço nacional de saúde)
cards.note: número de utente — your SNS user number
cards.ex_t: Ligue para o SNS 24 antes de ir às urgências.
cards.ex_trans: Call SNS 24 before going to A&E.

cards.note: historically Correios, Telégrafos e Telefones
cards.ex_t: A encomenda está nos CTT.
cards.ex_trans: The parcel is at the post office.

cards.note: MB Way — the phone payment app on top of it
cards.ex_t: Paga-se por MB Way ou dinheiro.
cards.ex_trans: Pay by MB Way or cash.

cards.note: Portuguese ones start with PT50
cards.ex_t: Manda-me o IBAN para a transferência.
cards.ex_trans: Send me your IBAN for the transfer.

cards.note: polices the countryside and roads; PSP does the cities
cards.ex_t: A GNR fazia controlo de velocidade na via rápida.
cards.ex_trans: The GNR was running a speed check on the expressway.

cards.trans: public security police (polícia de segurança pública)
cards.ex_t: A esquadra da PSP fica na avenida.
cards.ex_trans: The PSP station is on the avenue.

cards.trans: migration agency (agência para a integração, migrações e asilo)
cards.note: ex-SEF; the queue every immigrant knows
cards.ex_t: A marcação na AIMA é para novembro.
cards.ex_trans: The AIMA appointment is for November.

cards.note: no comboios on Madeira — mainland vocabulary
cards.ex_t: O site da CP vende os bilhetes com desconto antecipado.
cards.ex_trans: The CP site sells tickets with an early discount.

cards.note: EN101 rings Madeira; VR/VE are the fast ones
cards.ex_t: A EN antiga é lenta mas bonita.
cards.ex_trans: The old national road is slow but beautiful.

cards.note: Madeira's VR1 — the island's spine
cards.ex_t: Na VR1 o limite é oitenta em parte do traçado.
cards.ex_trans: On the VR1 the limit is eighty on part of the route.

cards.note: T0 is a studio; the T counts bedrooms, not rooms
cards.say: tê um, tê dois, tê três
cards.ex_t: Procuro um T2 com varanda.
cards.ex_trans: I'm looking for a two-bedroom with a balcony.

cards.note: in addresses: R/C Dto = ground floor, right door
cards.ex_t: A loja é no r/c do prédio azul.
cards.ex_trans: The shop is on the ground floor of the blue building.

cards.note: the address suffix couriers live by
cards.ex_t: Moro no segundo Esq.
cards.ex_trans: I live on the second floor, left door.

cards.note: on signs and forms; p.f. (por favor) too
cards.ex_t: Fechar a porta, s.f.f.
cards.ex_trans: Close the door, please.

cards.note: every Portuguese recipe: sal q.b.
cards.ex_t: Sal e pimenta q.b.
cards.ex_trans: Salt and pepper to taste.

cards.note: shop windows count the week: 2.ª a 6.ª — Mon to Fri
cards.ex_t: Aberto de 2.ª a 6.ª, das 9 às 18.
cards.ex_trans: Open Mon–Fri, 9 to 18.

cards.note: menus: bica c/ leite; quarto s/ vista
cards.ex_t: Sandes c/ queijo, s/ manteiga.
cards.ex_trans: Sandwich with cheese, without butter.

cards.trans: property purchase tax (imposto municipal sobre transmissões)
cards.note: the tax that ambushes first-time buyers
cards.ex_t: Contas com o IMT antes de fazer proposta.
cards.ex_trans: Budget for the IMT before making an offer.

cards.trans: annual property tax (imposto municipal sobre imóveis)
cards.ex_t: O IMI paga-se em maio, ou em prestações.
cards.ex_trans: The property tax is paid in May, or in instalments.

cards.note: on Madeira it's EEM — Empresa de Eletricidade da Madeira
cards.ex_t: A fatura da EDP chegou mais alta este mês.
cards.ex_trans: The electricity bill came higher this month.

cards.ex_t: A TAP mudou o horário do voo outra vez.
cards.ex_trans: TAP changed the flight time again.

cards.trans: small and medium business (pequena e média empresa)
cards.ex_t: Há apoios novos para PME este trimestre.
cards.ex_trans: There are new supports for SMEs this quarter.

cards.note: pronounced cê-vê; curriculum in full also heard
cards.ex_t: Envie o CV em PDF, s.f.f.
cards.ex_trans: Send the CV as a PDF, please.

cards.trans: social security number (número de identificação da segurança social)
cards.note: the freelancer's second-most-typed number after the NIF
cards.ex_t: Para recibos verdes precisa do NISS.
cards.ex_trans: For freelance invoicing you need the NISS.

cards.ex_t: As recomendações da DGS mudaram.
cards.ex_trans: The DGS guidelines changed.

cards.trans: GPS — but say it the Portuguese way
cards.note: gê-pê-ésse; asking for directions? locals trust landmarks more
cards.ex_t: O GPS manda sempre pela estrada antiga.
cards.ex_trans: The GPS always sends you down the old road.
